description: Read the effective semantic rhythm profile by family, including project-local overrides under a contained .basecoat/rhythm.json. Semantic IDs and approved implementation utilities are returned separately. Results are content-addressed and cursor-paginated; changed effective revisions invalidate prior cursors.

componentId.description: Alternative identifier alias for profile or family.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for bounded continuation of rhythm rules.

family.description: Semantic rhythm family to filter by (e.g. "spacing", "layout", "typography", "colors", "elevation"). Accepts aliases like "layouts".

id.description: Alternative identifier alias for profile or family.

limit.description: Maximum number of rhythm mappings to return per page (1-32, default 10).

name.description: Alternative identifier alias for profile or family.

profile.description: Rhythm profile identifier to query (e.g. "default", "compact", "comfortable"). Defaults to "default".

name: get_rhythm_rules
